countries.reasoning: China is the dominant global producer of amino acids due to its vast chemical manufacturing industry. Data based on recent industry reports from 2023 and Chinese government statistics, considered very reliable.
The U.S. has significant amino acid production primarily for animal feed and pharmaceuticals, supported by industry reports from 2022-2023, with solid data but less compared to China.
Japan is a major amino acid producer, focused on food and pharma applications; production data from trade associations and industry reports from 2023 are reliable.
Germany has significant chemical manufacturing capabilities with amino acid production; EU industry data from 2022-2023 supports this share with moderate confidence.
South Korea's production is notable, primarily from large chemical companies; data is less comprehensive but recent enough to give reasonable estimates.
